title: 第266章 快服下听话第265章 那我们就约定好了
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陆霜一直紧盯着她的神色变化，看见阁主突然脸红，眼底的疑惑更重，心里满是怀疑，总觉得刚刚里头一定发生了什么事。
楚青辞连忙收敛纷乱的心绪，强行摆正脸色，压下脸上的羞涩，语气沉稳地开口吩咐：“小霜，立刻把丹仙阁的人全部召集回来待命。
葛少威吃了这么大的亏，绝对不会就此罢休，后续肯定会前来报复，我们必须提前做好防备。”
“是，阁主！”陆霜立刻应声领命。
她当即走到一旁，拿出手机快速拨通电话，着手安排召集人手的事宜。
楚青辞目光又望向陈阳消失的夜空方向，眼底思绪翻涌，久久没有收回目光。
而在不远处的一栋高楼楼顶，夜风呼啸，陈阳负手而立，静静回望丹仙阁别墅的方向。
他眼底带着几分异样的思绪，低声自语：“看来想要和她达成双修还急不来，只能一步步慢慢铺垫。”
话音落下，他身形一动，脚下灵力浮动，直接御空而起，化作一道残影，朝着市区方向飞驰而去。
片刻之后，陈阳已然回到汕城大酒店的房间。
关上房门，室内瞬间变得安静私密。
他径直走到床边，盘膝坐在床上。
他神色沉静，抬手从灵戒取出一瓶消力丹服下。
紧跟着直接运功消化从萧戮、洪石几人身上吸收而来的修为力量。
时间缓缓流逝，一股股精纯灵力在经脉中流转游走，不断冲刷肉身、滋养丹田。
没过多久，他吸收的所有零散力量尽数消化完毕，全部转化为自身浑厚真气，稳稳汇入丹田之中，夯实自身修为根基。
稳住修为后，陈阳从灵戒取出楚青辞赠送的白玉瓷瓶，拧开瓶口，直接倒出两颗半仙品强体丹，仰头服入腹中。
丹药入喉即化，小腹丹田瞬间滋生出一股磅礴厚重的力量，顺着经脉流转四肢百骸。
陈阳不敢松懈，立刻摒除杂念，静心盘坐，全力消化这股强横药力。
待这两股药力彻底消化殆尽，他没有停顿，继续倒出丹药接连服用、炼化。

一夜时间，他始终保持着服药、炼化、沉淀的状态，循环往复，稳步提升实力。
不知不觉间，窗外夜色褪去，天色缓缓大亮，清晨微光透过窗户洒入房间。
陈阳缓缓睁开双眼，眼底精光内敛，眉宇间满是难以掩饰的欣喜。
经过一晚不间断的服药炼化与沉淀突破，他的修为已经从原本的炼气境八层中期，直接跳过八层后期，稳稳突破至炼气境九层前期！
不止修为精进，他的肉身强度、筋骨韧性也随之大幅提升，肉身力量暴涨一截，整体实力暴涨数倍。
陈阳心底满是狂喜，整个人状态极佳。
一会，陈阳想到什么，压下心底的欢喜，心念一动，将神识探入纳戒之中。
只见原本一直在纳戒中躺着的白若兰，此刻已然端正地盘坐其中，气息平稳醇厚，周身灵力充盈，显然已经彻底消化完昨晚他给她灌输的功力。
陈阳指尖灵光一闪，一道柔和灵力打出，直接将白若兰从纳戒中释放出来。
content_en:
Lu Shuang had been watching the change in her expression closely. When she saw the pavilion master suddenly blushing, the confusion in his eyes became heavier, and his heart was full of doubts. He always felt that something must have happened inside just now.
Chu Qingci quickly calmed down her chaotic thoughts, forcibly straightened her expression, suppressed the shyness on her face, and said in a calm tone: "Xiao Shuang, call all the people in Danxian Pavilion back immediately and stand by.
Ge Shaowei has suffered such a big loss and will never give up. He will definitely come to take revenge in the future. We must be prepared in advance. "
"Yes, Pavilion Master!" Lu Shuang immediately accepted the order.
She immediately walked aside, took out her mobile phone and quickly dialed the number to start arranging the recruitment of people.
Chu Qingci looked towards the direction of the night sky where Chen Yang disappeared. Thoughts surged in his eyes, and he did not look away for a long time.
On the roof of a tall building not far away, the night wind howled, Chen Yang stood with his hands behind his hands, looking back quietly in the direction of the Danxian Pavilion Villa.
With some strange thoughts in his eyes, he whispered to himself: "It seems that I can't rush to achieve dual cultivation with her, so I can only lay the groundwork step by step."
As soon as he finished speaking, he moved, his spiritual power floated under his feet, he rose directly into the air, turned into an afterimage, and flew towards the city.
After a while, Chen Yang returned to his room at Shancheng Hotel.
After closing the door, the room instantly became quiet and private.
He walked straight to the bed and sat cross-legged on the bed.
With a calm look on his face, he raised his hand and took out a bottle of Xiaoli Dan from the spiritual ring and drank it.
Then he directly used his kung fu to digest the cultivation power absorbed from Xiao Lu and Hong Shi.
Time passes slowly, and streams of pure spiritual power circulate in the meridians, constantly washing the physical body and nourishing the Dantian.
It didn't take long for all the scattered power he absorbed to be digested and transformed into his own rich true energy, which was steadily integrated into his dantian and consolidated the foundation of his own cultivation.
After stabilizing his cultivation, Chen Yang took out the white jade porcelain bottle presented by Chu Qingci from the spiritual ring, unscrewed the mouth of the bottle, poured out two semi-immortal grade body-strengthening pills, raised his head and drank them into his belly.
The elixir melts as soon as it enters the throat, and a majestic and heavy force instantly emerges from the Dantian in the lower abdomen, flowing along the meridians and throughout the limbs.
Chen Yang didn't dare to relax, he immediately got rid of distracting thoughts, sat in the cross-legged position, and tried his best to digest the powerful medicinal power.
After the two medicinal powers were completely digested, he continued to pour out the elixirs, take them, and refine them one after another without stopping.
Over the course of one night, he kept in the state of taking medicine, refining, and precipitating, repeating the cycle, steadily improving his strength.
Unknowingly, the night outside the window faded, the sky slowly brightened, and the early morning light spilled into the room through the window.
Chen Yang slowly opened his eyes, his eyes were bright and introverted, and his brows were filled with unconcealable joy.
After a night of uninterrupted medication, refining, and precipitation breakthrough, his cultivation level has jumped from the original middle level of the eighth level of Qi Refining Realm to the late eighth level, and has steadily broken through to the early stage of the ninth level of Qi Refining Realm!
Not only has his cultivation improved, but his physical strength and the toughness of his muscles and bones have also been greatly improved. His physical strength has skyrocketed, and his overall strength has skyrocketed several times.
Chen Yang's heart was filled with ecstasy, and his whole body was in excellent condition.
After a while, Chen Yang thought of something, suppressed the joy in his heart, and with a thought, he put his spiritual consciousness into Najie.
I saw Bai Ruolan, who had been lying in the Najie, now sitting in the cross-legged position upright, with a steady and mellow breath, and full of spiritual energy around her body. It was obvious that she had completely digested the skills he instilled in her last night.
A flash of light flashed from Chen Yang's fingertips, and a soft spiritual power shot out, directly releasing Bai Ruolan from the ring.
